snippet.title: Blocksworld - Play & Build Fun 3D Games
snippet.description:
Please support Kickstarter https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/blocksworld/blocksworld-revival/

Visit http://www.blocksworld.com to learn more.

Blocksworld is a lighthearted build-and-play system for kids and grownups alike that brings the imaginative play of toy blocks to your gaming device, allowing you to bring your digital creations to life. 

Snap together colorful 3D blocks to create anything you can imagine - from crazy characters to cars, space rockets, animals, robots, planes, monsters, and much more - and then bring your creations to life and play with them! 

Simple drag-and-drop controls make it easy to add interactivity and animations to anything you make. Tap "Play" and get ready to smile as your creations walk and talk, jump, drive, fly, shoot lasers, fire rockets, or even explode.

Coming back soon to the iPad and iPhone! 
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/blocksworld-hd/id665886336?ls=1&mt=8
and Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/642390/Blocksworld/

Play over 30 million worlds made by players!
Make your own games!
Play in virtual reality!
Make and share models!
